title: Cogs & Chaos
description: My personal favorite Create mods, with Origins. I may or may not update it. (I probably won't because I just made it for fun.)
body:
My personal favorite Create/Origin mods, plus other miscellaneous mods. I will most likely not be updating this modpack because I just made it in my spare time, but I might.

Main Create/Origin Mods:
- Create Big Cannons
- Create Enchantment Industry Fabric
- Create Fabric
- Create Slice & Dice
- Create: Bells & Whistles
- Create: Copycats+
- Create: Steam 'n' Rails
- Create: Origins
- Origins
- Origins ++
- Origins Randomiser
